summary.text: Steven Rhoads is a Republican state senator who represents New York State Senate District 5 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Rhoads is an attorney and former Nassau County legislator who has been a state senator since 2023; he is the Republican and Conservative Party candidate.

paragraphs.text: Steven Rhoads was born in Plainview, New York, lives in Bellmore, and graduated from Wantagh High School.
He earned a B.A. in political science and history from the State University of New York at Albany in 1991 and a J.D. from Hofstra University in 1994.
His career experience includes private legal practice, work as a deputy bureau chief in the Nassau County Attorney's office, service as a volunteer firefighter, and work as a youth minister.
Rhoads served as the legislator for Nassau County's 19th District and has represented State Senate District 5 since 2023, succeeding James Gaughran (D).

In the 2025-2026 session he is ranking member of the Ethics and Internal Governance Committee and the Labor Committee, and is also assigned to the Budget and Revenue, Health, Judiciary, and Procurement and Contracts committees.
In the November 3, 2026 general election, Rhoads faces Andrew Piddoubny (D).
